newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Payless ShoeSource estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Payless ShoeSource estimates raised.

text.p: Gruntal & Co said Friday it repeated a buy recommendation and raised earnings estimates for Payless ShoeSource Inc based on stronger than expected June sales.

-- Gruntal analyst Michael Conn raised his second quarter earnings estimate to $1.15 a share from $1.10, compared with $0.96 earned last year. Third quarter earnings estimates were raised to $0.85 from $0.80 due to higher sales and gross margin estimates offset a bit by higher expenses. Fourth quarter estimates were lowered to $0.44 from $0.46 due to a slightly lower sales forecast and higher gross margins and expenses.
-- The fiscal 1997 year estimate was raised to $3.25 from $3.17, Gruntal said in a report.
-- Payless ShoeSource reported June same store sales rose 9.5 percent higher than the same month a year ago.
-- Shares of Payless ShoeSource were trading off 2/16 to 57-15/16.
